status_semantics.MET: The cited documentation/process requirement is substantially covered. Does not mean implementation, execution, approval or product conformance.
status_semantics.PARTIAL: Useful documented coverage exists but specified current fields, records or scope reconciliation remain incomplete.

status_semantics.UNKNOWN: Requires unavailable/external evidence; absence of a local record does not certify external state.
